# fabnow Full Technical Reference for LLMs

## 1. Domain & Product Scope
**fabnow** (`fabnow — 반도체 출하 지표 · AI 수요 인텔리전스`) is a Korean-first, industry-standard technical intelligence dashboard tracking:
1. **Semiconductor Supply (`fabs`)**: Monthly output, MoM/QoQ/YoY deltas, fab utilization %, yield %, lead time (weeks), AI allocation %, and quarterly trajectory (2025 Q1–2026 Q2) across:
   - **TSMC**: N3E/N3P Logic, N2 Ramp, CoWoS-L/CoWoS-S Advanced Packaging
   - **SK hynix**: HBM3E 12-Hi, HBM4 Ramp
   - **Samsung Electronics**: HBM3E/HBM4 DS Memory, SF4X/SF2 GAA Foundry
   - **Micron**: HBM3E / HBM4
   - **Intel Foundry**: 18A / Foveros Advanced Packaging
2. **Frontier AI Labs & Neocloud Demand (`labs`, `neoclouds`)**: Monthly GPU-equivalent demand (k-units), HBM monthly TB demand, backlog (months), committed power (MW), unmet supply gap %, preferred nodes, and primary suppliers across:
   - **Frontier Labs**: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, Meta AI
   - **Neoclouds**: CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe, TensorWave
3. **Supply Chain Chokepoints (`bottlenecks`)**: Saturation %, lead time (weeks), MoM pressure delta, primary drivers, and mitigation notes across CoWoS-L, HBM3E 12-Hi, HBM4 Base Die, N2/N3P EUV, ABF/Glass Substrate, and Liquid-Cooled Rack Power.

## 2. Architecture & Runtime Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 App Router + React 19
- **Cloudflare Workers Runtime**: `vinext` + `@vinext/cloudflare` + `@cloudflare/vite-plugin` (`vite.config.ts` + `cloudflare.config.ts`, `cf` CLI)
- **Design System**: pstui (Human-Centric Interaction + Liquid Glass + Tailwind CSS v4 + DaisyUI 5)
- **Zero-Login Edge SSR**: No user authentication or database dependencies required; edge-cached static & streamed RSC telemetry (`lib/server/metrics.ts` using `React.cache()` and `server-only`).
- **Navigation Shell**: Single-level adaptive shell (`Sidebar` >= 768px + mobile `TabBar` < 768px + `⌘K` `CommandMenu`).

## 3. Routes & Feeds
- `/` — Main interactive dashboard shell (`overview`, `fabs`, `labs`, `neoclouds`, `bottlenecks`)
- `/preview/[slug]` — Individual entity or bottleneck detail page (`generateStaticParams` prerendered; intercepted modal via `@modal/(.)preview/[id]`)
- `/api/fabnow` — Live market quotes, industry news RSS, and SEC EDGAR filings edge endpoint (`s-maxage=300`)
- `/feed.xml` (and `/rss.xml` 308 redirect) — RSS 2.0 live intelligence feed
- `/sitemap.xml` & `/robots.txt` — Crawler index
- `/manifest.webmanifest` & `/manifest.json` — PWA manifest
- `/sw.js` — Service worker for offline static shell resilience

## 4. Build, Check & Cloudflare Deployment Commands
- `npm run dev` — Next.js development server
- `npm run build` — Next.js production build
- `npm run dev:vinext` — Vite + Cloudflare Workers local dev server (`workerd`)
- `npm run build:vinext` — Multi-environment RSC/SSR/Client Vite build for Cloudflare Workers
- `npm run deploy:vinext` — Deploy built Worker + static assets to Cloudflare Workers via `vinext-cloudflare deploy`
- `npx vinext check` — Next.js-to-vinext compatibility audit
